RaggieSoft Backstage: Behind the Scenes & In-Universe Bonus Features

Every Ocean View Archives novel stays tightly anchored to its narrator's lived, in-the-moment point of view. RaggieSoft Backstage opens the closed doors down the hall—revealing what happened across the courtyard at Roosevelt Rehabilitation Center, inside the Virginia State Capitol and Dirksen Room 511, and across the campus of Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI).

New Collection Now Live — Katie & Nathaniel Behind-the-Scenes Archive (14 Dossiers, 2001–2044): Explore how Barton Hall staff tracked Nate and Katie to the Rec Hall at 11:00 PM (and why locking a notorious hookup closet's door is what actually got them caught), Majority Leader Richard Callaway's closed-door post-mortem on HB 663, Commissioner Sterling and Director Cross's nine stages of panic in Dirksen Room 511, and three-term Senator Katie Prairie's 2044 Route 15 Bus-Stop Primary.

About RaggieSoft Backstage & In-Reader Bonus Features

Every Ocean View Archives novel is written strictly from its narrator's lived perspective (such as Nathaniel Prairie's first-person POV in Katie & Nathaniel or Jordan's third-person limited POV in The Eleventh Child). Keeping events the narrator wasn't present to witness inside RaggieSoft Backstage preserves complete narrative immersion while letting readers explore the full backstage truth at the end of the chapter.

Whenever a chapter on RaggieSoft Book Reader has a companion Backstage dossier, you'll see a Behind the Scenes / Bonus Feature card at the bottom of the chapter. Clicking the button opens the full archival dossier right on the page without losing your reading spot—or you can browse every collection directly here on RaggieSoft Backstage.
